facts.text: Full-time undergraduate students are eligible to apply for dual admission into accelerated professional degree programs that combine a bachelor's and doctor of osteopathic medicine degree in six, seven, or eight years.

sources.title: Osteopathic Medicine | Dual Admission
sources.quote: Earn both your bachelor's and your doctorate in six years (2+4), seven years (3+4), or eight years (4+4).
